items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I actually just came with a bass and a suitcase and I had a phone number in my book for Murray Wall.

ctx.x: At that time did you think you know what — I think I could make a living at this. Did you come here with that idea or did it sort of evolve?

Well that’s a good question because who knows. When you come to a city like New York, I mean you really have to know that once you emigrate to a country where things are done slightly different than Australia, it’s really, I like that expression “get in line.” Look how many bass players have really made their mark in New York City, and have for a long time, have great reputations. So it was really like get to the back of the line, unless you came to New York already knowing twenty people that were going to…
